card.name: Words leading into treatment response terms
card.fires_on: Small words like "a", "or" or "achieve" right before a response term such as complete response, partial response, CR or CRi, in oncology dosing instructions.

modes.label: Article before response
modes.description: The word "a" after achieve, had or is, just before complete or partial response.
